# `adt badi`

ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation operations

```bash
adt badi [options] [command] [name]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                            | Default |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `[name]` | BAdI / enhancement implementation name |         |

**Options**

| Option              | Description                                                         | Default |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--implementations` | List BAdI implementations carried by the enhancement implementation |         |
| `--json`            | Output metadata and implementations as JSON                         |         |

**Subcommands**

| Command             | Description                                                    |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt badi create`   | Create a new ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation            |
| `adt badi read`     | Read source code of an ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation  |
| `adt badi write`    | Write source code to an ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation |
| `adt badi activate` | Activate one or more ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation(s) |
| `adt badi delete`   | Delete an ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation               |

## `adt badi create`

Create a new ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation

```bash
adt badi create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description                            | Default |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | BAdI / enhancement implementation name |         |
| `<description>` | Short description                      |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name                           |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                                              | Default |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number                                 |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if BAdI / enhancement implementation already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                                           |         |

## `adt badi read`

Read source code of an ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation

```bash
adt badi read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                            | Default |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | BAdI / enhancement implementation name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt badi write`

Write source code to an ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation

```bash
adt badi write [options] <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                            | Default |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | BAdI / enhancement implementation name |         |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin)     | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

## `adt badi activate`

Activate one or more ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation(s)

```bash
adt badi activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                               | Default |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | BAdI / enhancement implementation name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt badi delete`

Delete an ABAP BAdI / enhancement implementation

```bash
adt badi delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                            | Default |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | BAdI / enhancement implementation name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
